approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
first_installment_sketch: The directive's own worked example: Website says Mon-Fri 8-5, the owner says 24/7 emergency service, another provider says Mon-Sat. Show PING preserving all three contradictory observations and explaining its current projection instead of outputting a magically resolved 'Open 24/7'. Real FYD conflict cases replace the schematic example as they are verified.
inputs: a real contradiction between sources: website, owner, provider, crawler, evidence
the preserved observations and the reasoning for the current projection
name: CONFLICTS
outputs: a standing proof that conflict preservation beats fake omniscience
purpose: Show PING preserving contradictory observations and explaining its current projection instead of resolving conflicts silently.
template: Present the sources side by side, each with its provenance (who said it, when, from where). Then show what PING did NOT do: magically output one resolved answer. Then show what it did: preserve the contradiction, explain the current projection, and name what would change it. Rule: never let the post read as omniscience; the credibility is in the preserved disagreement and the explainable projection.
